review:
A 5x4 street fighter where Fist symbols rise into wild reels from wherever they land – but only if the full reel would join a win. Fists belong to the red or blue team, and punching through a fighter from the other team (or a wild) adds a multiplier.

You can choose which fighters stand beside the grid, though Hacksaw says it doesn't affect results. In the bonus, the two teams compete to raise their Victory Level. Two bonus levels, 10,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
